description: This file contains a PHP unit test class for the EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI, which is part of the OrangeHRM Time API. The test class includes various test methods to verify API functionalities such as 'getAll', 'update', and checks for unimplemented methods like 'create', 'delete', and 'getOne'. It uses test data fixtures, mocks services, and asserts correct behavior of the API endpoints within an integration testing context.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetItemAPITest
